whatToTest: Start with your style notes, then create your digital twin. Add a few pieces from the wardrobe you own and see today’s looks styled on you. Notice when Robes suggests a new piece to finish a look. Plan your week ahead, then log your OOTDs, including one from last week.
betaDescription: Robes is your personal stylist. Daily looks from the wardrobe you own, styled on your digital twin. A new piece only when it finishes a look. Plan your week ahead, and keep track of your OOTDs.
